description: This file defines a class 'MembershipMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring the membership-related menu screen within the OrangeHRM admin module, overriding the screen to 'membership'.

classes.name: MembershipMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for membership menu in OrangeHRM admin module, overrides screen to 'membership'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu screen by overriding the screen to 'membership' and returning null.
